Frequently asked questions

How many Business Analyst jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 41 open Business Analyst jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

How much do Business Analyst jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $56,393–$76,000 a year, based on 11 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Business Analyst jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include CGI Technologies and Solutions, Inc. (4 listings), AECOM (2 listings), Dhalite Inc. (2 listings), SiloSmashers (2 listings), and ThinkTek (2 listings).

Do any Business Analyst jobs in the United States mention visa sponsorship or OPT?

1 listing mentions visa sponsorship or OPT/CPT. A mention does not guarantee sponsorship or eligibility; confirm with the employer.

Do I need experience?

These listings match explicit entry-level, junior, graduate or early-career titles. A title alone does not confirm an experience requirement; review the original posting.
